title: Moved to company-wide software excellence to lead technical debt reduction
summary: In July 2019 I left the architect role on one product for the Software Center of Excellence, with a remit to help every business improve its software practices and to lead initiatives such as technical debt reduction.
what_would_have_happened: Improvements would have stayed inside one product team.
the_call: Trade a product architect role for one that reaches every business.
what_i_did: Took the competency specialist role for software excellence, announced to the whole campus, and started working with teams across businesses.
what_changed: It started the programs I went on to lead: duplication detection, code-craft assessments, the bar-raiser program and outreach across 100+ teams.

quotes.text: In his journey with Philips, his passion for software excellence has gravitated him towards taking up a role with Software Center of Excellence.
